subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 17-2199.03, perform load analysis, system modeling and simulation, scheme design, engineering calculations, and energy efficiency estimation for industrial and building energy systems, producing reviewable design descriptions and calculation books; excludes wind and solar specializations.
